name: wot
description: Advice grounded in one World of Tanks account's own data: the wot-advisor skill, the wotctx MCP server, /wot:sync, and a sync at session start. Needs wotctx on the PATH (make install) and a Wargaming login (wotctx auth wg).

inject_brief.title: Brief at session start
inject_brief.description: Add the cached account brief (about 4,500 characters) to the context of every new Claude Code session. Off by default: the plugin runs in every session, including ones that are not about World of Tanks, and the skill reads the brief anyway when a question needs it.
